mapper.select: SELECT id, from_point_id, to_point_id, relation_type, source, status, created_by, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, created_at FROM knowledge_point_relations WHERE from_point_id = #{knowledgePointId} OR to_point_id = #{knowledgePointId} ORDER BY id

WITH RECURSIVE prereqs(point_id) AS ( SELECT r.from_point_id FROM knowledge_point_relations r JOIN knowledge_points kp ON r.to_point_id = kp.id WHERE kp.course_id = #{courseId} AND r.relation_type = 'PREREQUISITE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' UNION SELECT r.from_point_id FROM knowledge_point_relations r INNER JOIN prereqs ON r.to_point_id = prereqs.point_id WHERE r.relation_type = 'PREREQUISITE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' )

SELECT relation.id, relation.from_point_id, relation.to_point_id, relation.relation_type, relation.source, relation.status, relation.created_by, relation.reviewed_by, relation.reviewed_at, relation.created_at FROM knowledge_point_relations relation INNER JOIN knowledge_points from_point ON from_point.id = relation.from_point_id INNER JOIN knowledge_points to_point ON to_point.id = relation.to_point_id WHERE (from_point.course_id = #{courseId} OR to_point.course_id = #{courseId}) AND relation.relation_type = 'CONFUSABLE' AND relation.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY relation.id
